title: Reception of the UECapabilityEnquiry by the UE

entities.name: Reception of UECapabilityEnquiry
entities.description: Procedure executed by UE upon receiving UECapabilityEnquiry message to determine which UE capabilities to include in response.

entities.name: UECapabilityInformation
entities.description: RRC message sent by UE in response to UECapabilityEnquiry, containing UE radio capability information.

entities.name: ue-CapabilityRAT-RequestList
entities.description: Information element in UECapabilityEnquiry message specifying which RAT capabilities are requested.

entities.name: ue-CapabilityRAT-ContainerList
entities.description: Information element in UECapabilityInformation message containing UE capability containers for different RATs.

entities.name: rat-Type set to nr
entities.description: Condition checking if UE-CapabilityRAT-Request has rat-Type set to NR.

entities.name: rat-Type set to eutra-nr
entities.description: Condition checking if UE-CapabilityRAT-Request has rat-Type set to E-UTRA-NR.

entities.name: rat-Type set to eutra
entities.description: Condition checking if UE-CapabilityRAT-Request has rat-Type set to E-UTRA.

entities.name: rat-Type set to utra-fdd
entities.description: Condition checking if UE-CapabilityRAT-Request has rat-Type set to UTRA-FDD.

entities.name: UE supports (NG)EN-DC or NE-DC
entities.description: Condition checking if UE supports EN-DC, NGEN-DC, or NE-DC dual connectivity.

entities.name: UE supports E-UTRA
entities.description: Condition checking if UE supports E-UTRA capabilities.

entities.name: UE supports UTRA-FDD
entities.description: Condition checking if UE supports UTRA-FDD capabilities.

entities.name: RRC message segmentation required
entities.description: Condition checking if RRC message segmentation is enabled and encoded message exceeds PDCP SDU size limit.

entities.name: UL message segment transfer procedure
entities.description: Procedure for segmenting and transmitting large RRC messages when segmentation is required.

relations.description: Procedure includes constructing and transmitting UECapabilityInformation message.
Procedure execution depends on contents of ue-CapabilityRAT-RequestList IE.
When rat-Type is nr, UE includes NR capability container in ue-CapabilityRAT-ContainerList.
Inclusion of E-UTRA-NR capability container requires UE support for EN-DC/NE-DC.
When UE supports EN-DC/NE-DC, includes MRDC capability container in ue-CapabilityRAT-ContainerList.
Inclusion of E-UTRA capability container requires UE support for E-UTRA.
When UE supports E-UTRA, includes E-UTRA capability container in ue-CapabilityRAT-ContainerList.
Inclusion of UTRA-FDD capability container requires UE support for UTRA-FDD.
When UE supports UTRA-FDD, includes UTRA-FDD capability container in ue-CapabilityRAT-ContainerList.
When RRC message segmentation is required, UE initiates UL message segment transfer procedure.
